digest.component_or_area: CI linting gates and scripts/ directory
propositions: scripts/ is excluded from lint and typecheck gates, leaving 41 files and 78+ violations (50 T201 print, 28 substantive) ungated; seven invoked CI-gate scripts are themselves unvalidated

T201 (print) exemptions are scattered across nine per-file entries instead of one consolidated directory entry, and consolidation creates new RUF100 violations from now-redundant inline directives if not done atomically
Formatter nonconformance (7 files would be reformatted) is a separate failure class from check violations that must be resolved before scripts/ joins Makefile sources
28 substantive ruff check violations span five rule types (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1) with no live defects; 12 RUF100 directives reference disabled rules

Adding scripts/ to linting scope requires simultaneous consolidation of T201 per-file-ignores, deletion of 28 inline T201 directives, and formatter fixes to avoid introducing new violations between intermediate states
